values.note: Rates for 2 adults, 3 children and one vehicle. Standard back-in sites: $35 in the off season (April 17 - May 21, September 27 - October 18), $50 on weekdays May 26 - June 5 and September 1-25, $60 on summer weekdays (June 6 - August 27) and shoulder weekends, $78 on Halloween weekends, $84 on summer and holiday weekends. Pull-through and VIP sites run $40-45 off season to $90-101. A 1-night reservation on a VIP or pull-through site costs $25 more. The park adds a 3.5% processing fee and Campspot its own booking fee.

note: Large family campground at Lodi, near Madison and the Wisconsin Dells, where a swimming pond has water inflatables and a beach; there is also mini golf, a jumping pillow, giant shopping-cart rides, two playgrounds and themed weekends through the season. Cabins, yurts, Conestoga wagons and park models are rented. Mostly seasonal: about 45 of its roughly 250 sites are sold by the night. --Claude
